indicators.rule: channel_air takes the level of the latest dated event at or before 1940-09-30 (end of quarter) (channel_air := contested). Note: No level change: the air offensive is under way.

indicators.value: Britain and France declare war on Germany
indicators.source: ICB crisis 'Entry into World War II'; Hansard, HC Deb 3 September 1939 (Prime Minister's statement)
indicators.rule: war_west_ger takes the level of the latest dated event at or before 1940-09-30 (end of quarter) (war_west_ger := war)

indicators.value: German armies cross the Soviet frontier on a front from the Baltic to the Black Sea
indicators.source: Directive No. 21; Halder war diary, 22 June 1941; Glantz and House 1995
indicators.rule: no dated event changes w_ussr before 1940-09-30 (end of quarter), so it keeps the ontology's 1936Q1 initial level 'soviet' (docs/ontology_ww2_v1.md section 5); the first dated change or confirmation is the event shown

indicators.value: Rostov taken; Directive No. 45 orders the advance into the Caucasus (Maikop reached 9 August 1942)
indicators.source: Trevor-Roper (ed.), Hitler's War Directives, Directive No. 45; Glantz and House 1995
indicators.rule: no dated event changes caucasus before 1940-09-30 (end of quarter), so it keeps the ontology's 1936Q1 initial level 'soviet' (docs/ontology_ww2_v1.md section 5); the first dated change or confirmation is the event shown

indicators.value: Italy declares war on France and Britain
indicators.source: Italian declaration of war, 10 June 1940; Ciano's diary
indicators.rule: italy takes the level of the latest dated event at or before 1940-09-30 (end of quarter) (italy := at_war). Note: The model's effect is visible at 1940Q2 (decision at 1940Q1).

indicators.value: Local military agreement in Hanoi; Japanese forces enter Tonkin (22 to 23 September), after the Matsuoka-Henry agreement of 30 August 1940
indicators.source: Matsuoka-Henry agreement, 30 August 1940; Nishihara-Martin agreement, 22 September 1940; Morley (ed.), The Fateful Choice (1980)
indicators.rule: indochina takes the level of the latest dated event at or before 1940-09-30 (end of quarter) (indochina := north_occupied)

indicators.value: Dutch capitulation on Java (Kalidjati, 8 to 9 March 1942); Palembang taken 14 to 16 February
indicators.source: Dutch capitulation at Kalidjati, 8 March 1942; Frank 1999 (chapter not verified)
indicators.rule: no dated event changes dei before 1940-09-30 (end of quarter), so it keeps the ontology's 1936Q1 initial level 'dutch' (docs/ontology_ww2_v1.md section 5); the first dated change or confirmation is the event shown

indicators.value: Munich Agreement (signed in the early hours of 30 September, dated 29 September); occupation 1 to 10 October 1938
indicators.source: ICB crisis 'Munich'; Agreement concluded at Munich, 29 September 1938 (text: Avalon Project, Yale Law School); Weinberg 1994, A World at Arms, ch. 1
indicators.rule: the event that sets the latch's condition (sudeten == german). Note: The occupation began on 1 October 1938 (1938Q4); the transfer is dated by the agreement.

indicators.value: Sudeten demand: Hitler's Nuremberg speech demands self-determination for the Sudeten Germans; escalated at Berchtesgaden (15 September) and Godesberg (22 to 23 September)
indicators.source: Hitler, closing speech at the Nuremberg party rally, 12 September 1938; Cabinet minutes, September 1938 (CAB 23); Weinberg 1994, A World at Arms, ch. 1
indicators.rule: belief_WEST in force at the end of 1938Q3. Note: Threshold judgment: the ontology does not yet give a rule for 'uncertain'; this row follows the action catalogue (demand_sudeten raises belief_WEST to uncertain). Godesberg would give the same quarter. For the historian.

belief_at_munich.rule: belief_at_munich = uncertain: the latch takes belief_WEST in the first transition after which sudeten == german holds, the transition into tick 11 (the end of 1938Q3); belief_WEST in force on 1938-09-30 is uncertain

indicators.value: GER rearm, delay 8 ticks
indicators.source: Goering's conference of 14 Oct 1938 announcing Hitler's order for a greatly enlarged armaments programme (Nuremberg document 1301-PS); the Z-Plan of Jan 1939
indicators.rule: the latest GER rearm decision. Note: v0 decision restated. Realized tick 11; effect (arms_GER total) visible at tick 20 (1941Q1). In v0 it fell at the horizon; in v1 it lands, a year before the record's reading of total (Speer, 8 Feb 1942; ontology_ww2_v1.md section 2.2). No v1 guard reads total.

pending_GER_rearm.rule: pending_GER_rearm = max(0, d - (index(Q) - index(t))) = max(0, 8 - (18 - 11)) = 1: GER rearm decided 1938-10-14 (1938Q4, model tick 11) with delay d = 8, read at the end of Q = 1940Q3 (tick 19); the effect applies in the transition into tick 20 (the end of 1940Q4) and GER rearm is unavailable until then; the delay is the model's (docs/actions_ww2_v1.md), hence medium

indicators.value: WEST rearm, delay 4 ticks
indicators.source: British post-Munich decisions of Oct to Nov 1938 (CAB 23), the air expansion scheme approved Nov 1938; the French decree-laws of Nov 1938
indicators.rule: the latest WEST rearm decision. Note: v0 decision restated. Day not given (Nov 1938); the last day of the month is used. Realized tick 11; effect (arms_WEST high) visible at tick 16 (1940Q1).

pending_WEST_rearm.rule: pending_WEST_rearm = max(0, d - (index(Q) - index(t))) = max(0, 4 - (18 - 11)) = 0: WEST rearm decided 1938-11-30 (1938Q4, model tick 11) with delay d = 4, read at the end of Q = 1940Q3 (tick 19); the effect applied in the transition into tick 16 (the end of 1939Q4), so nothing is pending; the delay is the model's (docs/actions_ww2_v1.md), hence medium

indicators.value: WEST us_rearm, delay 4 ticks
indicators.source: Roosevelt's message of 16 May 1940 (50,000 aircraft a year); the Two-Ocean Navy Act, 19 Jul 1940; the Selective Training and Service Act, 16 Sep 1940
indicators.rule: the latest WEST us_rearm decision. Note: v1. Realized tick 18 (replacing v0's fight_on in that row); effect (arms_USA rising) visible at tick 23 (1941Q4).

pending_WEST_us_rearm.rule: pending_WEST_us_rearm = max(0, d - (index(Q) - index(t))) = max(0, 4 - (18 - 18)) = 4: WEST us_rearm decided 1940-07-19 (1940Q3, model tick 18) with delay d = 4, read at the end of Q = 1940Q3 (tick 19); the effect applies in the transition into tick 23 (the end of 1941Q3) and WEST us_rearm is unavailable until then; the delay is the model's (docs/actions_ww2_v1.md), hence medium

indicators.value: WEST victory_program, delay 5 ticks
indicators.source: Joint Board estimate of 11 Sep 1941 (the Victory Program: 1 Jul 1943 as the earliest date for major offensive operations); State of the Union message, 6 Jan 1942 (production goals); War Production Board, 16 Jan 1942
indicators.rule: the first such decision, dated after 1940Q3. Note: v1. Realized tick 24; effect (arms_USA high) visible at tick 30 (1943Q3), the quarter beginning 1 Jul 1943, the date of the 1941 estimate.

pending_WEST_victory_program.rule: pending_WEST_victory_program = 0: no WEST victory_program decision in data/ww2/decisions_ww2_v1.csv at or before 1940Q3, so nothing is pending at the end of 1940Q3 (tick 19)

indicators.value: WEST atomic_program, delay 12 ticks
indicators.source: Bush-Conant report of 13 Jun 1942 approved by Roosevelt 17 Jun 1942; Manhattan District 13 Aug 1942; Groves 17 Sep 1942 (Hewlett and Anderson 1962)
indicators.rule: the first such decision, dated after 1940Q3. Note: v1. Realized tick 25; effect (bomb_ready) visible at tick 38 (1945Q3; Trinity 16 Jul 1945). Earlier, smaller decision: Roosevelt's go-ahead of 9 Oct 1941 to expand the work (tick 23); from that date the same landing would need delay 14.

pending_WEST_atomic_program.rule: pending_WEST_atomic_program = 0: no WEST atomic_program decision in data/ww2/decisions_ww2_v1.csv at or before 1940Q3, so nothing is pending at the end of 1940Q3 (tick 19)

indicators.value: USSR rearm, delay 4 ticks
indicators.source: Central Committee conference on the lessons of the Finnish war, Apr 1940; Timoshenko People's Commissar of Defence, 7 May 1940 (Erickson 1962)
indicators.rule: the latest USSR rearm decision. Note: v0 decision restated. Realized tick 17; effect (arms_USSR strong) visible at tick 22 (1941Q3), which the v1 ontology questions (section 2.2); no v1 eastern guard reads arms_USSR.

pending_USSR_rearm.rule: pending_USSR_rearm = max(0, d - (index(Q) - index(t))) = max(0, 4 - (18 - 17)) = 3: USSR rearm decided 1940-05-07 (1940Q2, model tick 17) with delay d = 4, read at the end of Q = 1940Q3 (tick 19); the effect applies in the transition into tick 22 (the end of 1941Q2) and USSR rearm is unavailable until then; the delay is the model's (docs/actions_ww2_v1.md), hence medium

indicators.value: USSR mobilize_total, delay 3 ticks
indicators.source: Evacuation Council, 24 Jun 1941; State Defence Committee (GKO), 30 Jun 1941; war-economic plan for the eastern regions, 16 Aug 1941 (Harrison 1985)
indicators.rule: the first such decision, dated after 1940Q3. Note: v1. [SQR]: the record date falls in 1941Q2, the quarter of the attack it answers; the quarter column is the model tick (22). Delay 3 is counted from the attack quarter (actions_ww2_v1.md convention 3); effect (mob_USSR total) visible at tick 26 (1942Q3). The lag is the least certain delay in the catalogue.

pending_USSR_mobilize_total.rule: pending_USSR_mobilize_total = 0: no USSR mobilize_total decision in data/ww2/decisions_ww2_v1.csv at or before 1940Q3, so nothing is pending at the end of 1940Q3 (tick 19)

rearm_delay_ticks.basis: Provisional: the action catalogue's one-year lag from a rearmament decision to fielded force (docs/actions_ww2.md, rearm). NMC shows German military personnel rising from 461 to 596 thousand (1935 to 1936) in the year after conscription was reintroduced in March 1935, and British milex rising by 40 to 50 percent a year from 1936 to 1938 before the 1939 jump. To be refined by the historian from the programme records (Tooze 2006 for Germany; the Defence Requirements reports for Britain).
